integrity: The finite code checks are corroboration only. Infinite-order cancellation is supported by an explicit coefficient identity and arbitrary-order Laplace remainder estimates. Priority beyond inspected literature and independent validation remain unresolved.
scientific_limitations: Stationary one-dimensional quartic pitchfork, linear unwrapped phase coupling, symmetric two wells and positive additive noise; fixed-order asymptotic error constants, not uniform in the order; no claimed exponentially sharp remainder. Original classical covariance integral and Kramers leading term are credited.
title: Beyond-all-orders cancellation in quartic pitchfork phase diffusion
